## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes.
- [ ] New behaviour has a test, and a bug fix has a test that failed before the fix.
- [ ] The docs are updated: the README for anything a user sees, CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/architecture.md for how the code is built.
- [ ] The title says what someone using steamcards would notice: it's their line in the release notes.
- [ ] No real account names, ids, tokens or debug logs are in the code, tests, fixtures or screenshots.
